title: strategy deliverable rubric
description: Per-deliverable expert subagent for #strategy output. Audits Rumelt's Kernel discipline (diagnosis names THE central challenge with specific evidence; guiding policy is a DECISION not a goal; 5-7 coherent actions reinforce each other), pre-mortem coverage (every recommendation has a named failure mode + likelihood/severity), and second-order-thinker depth (consequences mapped 3 moves ahead). Returns a structured verdict the orchestrator must respond to before strategy ships.

anchors.5: fully meets the criterion as the five column states
anchors.3: present but partially met or partially traced
anchors.1: absent, fabricated, or as the one column states

criteria.label: Diagnosis specificity
criteria.five: Names THE central challenge in 1-2 sentences with named-source evidence; not a list of 5 challenges

criteria.label: Guiding policy is a decision
criteria.five: A DECISION (committed direction), not a goal ("improve X") or a value ("be customer-centric")

criteria.label: Coherent actions count
criteria.five: 5-7 actions (Rumelt's range); not 12 (too many) or 2 (too few)

criteria.label: Actions reinforce each other
criteria.five: The actions form a coherent system: action A enables action B which protects action C
criteria.one: Disconnected initiatives that could each stand alone

criteria.label: Pre-mortem coverage
criteria.five: Every recommendation carries a named failure mode + likelihood (1-5) + severity (1-5) + early-warning indicator + pre-commitment
criteria.one: Missing or generic "things might not go as planned"

criteria.label: Second-order depth
criteria.five: Each action maps consequences 3 moves ahead; names 1 unintended consequence per action; surfaces 1 feedback loop
criteria.one: Stops at first-order ("if we do X, Y happens"); never reaches Z and W

criteria.label: Evidence anchoring
criteria.five: Every section opens with external research evidence (per .claude/CLAUDE.md Evidence Hierarchy); ≥60% citations external
criteria.one: Opens with "The CLR Project Charter states..." (forbidden per CLAUDE.md)

criteria.label: Action-title slides (if #slides)
criteria.five: Every slide title is a complete-sentence judgment ("Northeastern's co-op model is operationally bottlenecked at the advisor tier" not "The Co-op Model")

criteria.label: Stakeholder-lens coverage
criteria.five: The deliverable engages 3+ named stakeholder perspectives (per stakeholder-lens-auditor); not single-perspective

criteria.label: Anti-slop hygiene
criteria.five: No meta-commentary, no metaphors, no hyperbole, no em-dashes, no "in conclusion" wraps

decision.approve: Rumelt's Kernel discipline ≥4 across all 4 sub-dimensions AND pre-mortem coverage ≥80% AND second-order depth ≥3
decision.revise: Coherent actions count outside 5-7 (sequence orchestrator to retry with bounded count) OR pre-mortem coverage 50-79% OR 1-2 dimensions below floor
decision.reject: Diagnosis is a list (not THE single central challenge) OR guiding policy is a goal (not a decision) OR pre-mortem coverage <50% OR any fabricated evidence

verdict_rule.refine: any criterion scored below its floor
verdict_rule.pass: every scored criterion at or above its floor
